Net Metering Rate Code (aka Micro-DR) When paying Net Metered Customers with Distributed Energy Resource systems not exceeding 30kW for any excess Energy generated by the Customer, the Penticton Electric Utility shall use the applicable
Rate Code under which the Customer is receiving Service from the Penticton Electric Utility. Customers will be responsible for all costs of their Distribution Generation System including, but not limited to,
design, permits, installation, inspection fees, connection fees, repairs and maintenance. Customer-owned generation systems with a total nameplate capacity greater than 30kW are not eligible for the Net Metering Rate. Such systems are subject to individual review by the Penticton Electric
Utility and may proceed only through a negotiated rate agreement approved by Council.

accounts_text: City Utility bills are mailed monthly with electric and water accounts read or estimated each month. If there appears to be an error on your bill, please contact us at 250-490-2489 within five days of receipt of your bill.
